en_US: Hi!
Let’s get cooking!
Here’s my advice on cooking tasty
Poffins for your Pokémon crew!
In the beginning, while it’s still
a batter, swirl it gently and avoid
spillage.
When it starts to harden, churn it
fast in big circles!
At the end, make a wish for it to
turn scrumptious and whirl it!
Have you got some Berries?
To make delicious Poffins, the key
ingredient is a rare Berry.
And, the more cooks you have,
the more delicious the Poffin!
Eating good food makes people and
Pokémon more energetic and happy.
In that sense, we’re exactly alike.
At the Wi-Fi Club, I can cook up Poffins
with my friends!
Argh! Ow!
That hurts!
I was adding some boiling water to the
pot to prepare it for Poffin making,
and I spilt it all over me!
Do you have a Burn Heal?
It’d be really useful right now...
You don’t... That’s too bad.
Then I should get some cold water...
Ah! That’s much better.
Thank you very much.
In fact, I can do more than just
give thanks!
Here’s a Technical Machine--one that’ll
put a Pokémon in the same situation!
Scald is a Water-type move that
shoots boiling water at the opponent.
Pokémon won’t be hurt as badly as
I was, but that move can still leave
a nasty burn on its target!
Oh, fantastic!
Let me just apply it...
